title: 第37课 · 谁让你来的
subtitle: Lesson 37 — 谁让你来的 · Who told you to come

items.en: Who told you to come?

items.zh: 老师让我们写一篇作文。
items.py: Lǎoshī ràng wǒmen xiě yī piān zuòwén.
items.en: The teacher asked us to write an essay.

items.py: Māma bù ràng wǒ chūqù wán.
items.en: Mom won't let me go out to play.

items.py: Qǐng ràng wǒ xiǎng yi xiǎng.
items.en: Please let me think about it.

items.py: Tā jiào wǒ bāng tā mǎi dōngxi.
items.en: He asked me to buy things for him.

items.py: Zhè jiàn shì ràng wǒ hěn gāoxìng.
items.en: This matter makes me very happy.

items.py: Mǎlì: Dàwèi, nǐ zài zuò shénme?
items.en: Mary: David, what are you doing?

items.zh: 大卫：老师让我们写一篇作文。
items.py: Dàwèi: Lǎoshī ràng wǒmen xiě yī piān zuòwén.
items.en: David: The teacher asked us to write an essay.
Mary: What topic?

items.zh: 大卫：写我们在中国的生活。
items.py: Dàwèi: Xiě wǒmen zài Zhōngguó de shēnghuó.
items.en: David: About our life in China.

items.zh: 玛丽：这个题目很有意思。让我看看你写的。
items.py: Mǎlì: Zhège tímù hěn yǒu yìsi. Ràng wǒ kànkan nǐ xiě de.
items.en: Mary: Interesting topic. Let me see what you wrote.

items.zh: 大卫：还没写完呢。写完了让你看。
items.py: Dàwèi: Hái méi xiě wán ne. Xiě wán le ràng nǐ kàn.
items.en: David: Not finished yet. I'll let you see when I'm done.

items.zh: 和子：刘京，你周末能来参加我的生日会吗？
items.py: Hézǐ: Liú Jīng, nǐ zhōumò néng lái cānjiā wǒ de shēngrì huì ma?
items.en: Hezi: Liu Jing, can you come to my birthday party this weekend?

items.zh: 刘京：我得问问我妈妈。她有时候不让我晚上出去。
items.py: Liú Jīng: Wǒ děi wènwen wǒ māma. Tā yǒu shíhou bù ràng wǒ wǎnshang chūqù.
items.en: Liu Jing: I need to ask my mom. She sometimes doesn't let me go out at night.
Hezi: It's in the afternoon.

items.zh: 刘京：那没问题。她一定会让我去的。
items.py: Liú Jīng: Nà méi wèntí. Tā yīdìng huì ràng wǒ qù de.
items.en: Liu Jing: Then no problem. She'll definitely let me go.

items.zh: 和子：太好了！谁叫你来的？——你叫我来的！哈哈
items.py: Hézǐ: Tài hǎo le! Shéi jiào nǐ lái de? —— Nǐ jiào wǒ lái de! Hāhā
items.en: Hezi: Great! Who told you to come? — You did! Haha
to let; to make; to ask (sb to do sth)
to ask/tell (sb to do sth)
essay; composition
topic; title
must; have to
to participate; to attend
birthday
to notify; notice
to arrange
to ask for leave
to agree
to refuse; to reject
让 + person + verb: The teacher has us write.

items.py: Māma bù ràng wǒ kàn diànshì.
items.en: Mom doesn't let me watch TV.
He told me to wait a moment. (叫 = more informal)

items.py: Zhè jiàn shì ràng rén hěn nánguò.
items.en: This matter makes people sad. (让 = cause/make)
Please let me finish speaking.

items.zh: 老师让我们写作文。→ 老师让我们看课文。
items.py: Lǎoshī ràng wǒmen xiě zuòwén. → Lǎoshī ràng wǒmen kàn kèwén.
items.en: Teacher has us write. → Teacher has us read.

items.py: Māma ràng wǒ zǎodiǎnr huí jiā.
items.en: Mom asked me to go home early.
He won't let me go.
Please let me try.

items.zh: 谁让你来的？——老师让我来的。
items.py: Shéi ràng nǐ lái de? —— Lǎoshī ràng wǒ lái de.
items.en: Who told you to come? — The teacher.
